obfuscation_indicators: unable to estimate future sales or margins
may increase, decrease or idle production
risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial operating and financial quantification, including production capacity, volumes, pricing, costs, profitability and year-over-year changes. Risk remains material due to volatile commodity and crush margins, uncertainty in forecasting gross margins, and the temporary idling of the Magic Valley facility, although management emphasizes improved 2023 results and strategic mitigation efforts.
